evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml runs `npm ci`, `npm test` (pretest regenerates data) and `npm run build` (prepare-data + svelte-check + vite build) in site/ on pull_request, all real scripts in site/package.json. Top-level `permissions: contents: read`; deploy job only `pages: write`/`id-token: write`; release job only `contents: write`; only github.token used; no pull_request_target; nothing was run or published. Pages deploys on push to main (plus workflow_dispatch, which can be run from any branch and then relies on the environment's branch protection). Release only on v* tags and verifies the tag is an ancestor of origin/main. But no action is pinned to a commit SHA: actions/checkout@v7, actions/setup-node@v7 (ci.yml:50-51, pages.yml, release.yml:150), actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5, actions/deploy-pages@v5; commit ffea5b9 'use current action majors' made this deliberate.
evidence.s1_readme: README.md (step1.patch 286-377) covers layout, requirements, Install (`npm ci`), Develop (`npm run dev`, prepare-data, sample-bullets, preview), Test (`npm test`), Build (`npm run build`, PAGES_BASE which vite.config.ts:11 reads), Contribute data (issue templates exist in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE, file name = key, sample bullets), and License (MIT, LICENSE exists, THIRD-PARTY.md exists). Every npm script shown exists in site/package.json; the family list matches FAMILIES in scripts/records.mjs.
evidence.s1_release: Version kept in site/package.json `version` (0.1.0); CONTRIBUTING.md 'Versioning'/'Releasing' explains SemVer and the steps: npm version --no-git-tag-version, rename [Unreleased], `chore: release X.Y.Z`, tag the merge commit. release.yml checks tag == v+package version and a non-empty CHANGELOG section, then `gh release create`. CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 + SemVer. Dependabot covers npm in /site and github-actions, with build/ci prefixes matching the convention. Conventional Commits stated with a `data` type; all 10 commits in commits.txt comply.
evidence.s2_requirements: Route `#/compare/<a>/<b>` parsed in router.ts:34-42 with href.compare; hash route survives reload. Compare.svelte renders one SVG, role=img, aria-label `Profiles of {a} and {b}`, with one <path> per outline from caseOuterProfile via adaptMetallic in a shared viewportFor frame. Table: <caption> `Dimensions (mm|in)`, headers Symbol / name A / name B / Difference, row symbol via FIELD_LABELS, cartridge part only, Tol and FIELD_UNITS fields excluded, B−A. Units: formatValue for metric, displayNumber(…,'in') for imperial, reactive to unitSystem(). Cartridge.svelte adds a Label `Compare with` + NativeSelect of other entries by name + `Compare` submit button that navigates to href.compare(key, chosen). German strings added. Tests and changelog entry added.
evidence.s2_correctness: dimensions() walks cartridge groups in GROUP_ORDER, skips arrays (shot repeating groups), non-numbers, `*Tol` and FIELD_UNITS fields (α, β, δ, pressures, energies, M), so for 308 Win./300 Win. Mag. it gives L1, L2, L3, L6, R, R1, E, E1, e min, f, P1, P2, H1, H2, S, r1 min, r2, G1, L3 + G, Fe. Difference is y−x, written through the same writer; toPrecision(12) only strips float noise (66.55−51.18). Both profiles start at z=0 and share one Viewport, so head faces coincide on one axis. Missing keys, malformed escapes and undrawable records are handled; shot cartridges get no drawing.
evidence.s2_fit: Reuses @lib/core (FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, orderedFields, toleranceFor, formatValue, PX_PER_MM), @lib/geom (viewportFor, fullSectionPath, OUTLINE_STROKE_MM), @lib/shapes2d/case, site units.ts displayNumber, the shadcn Label/NativeSelect/Button, t(), and the router/App chunk/metadata patterns; the logic sits in site/src/lib/compare.ts with a colocated test like the other site libs. Minor duplication: the group ordering in compare.ts:144-147 copies orderedGroups in site/src/lib/fields.ts:19-27. Touched files are limited to what the route needs (App, SiteNavigation active state, metadata, router, i18n, Cartridge).
evidence.s2_tests: compare.test.ts tests compareRows: Tol, FIELD_UNITS fields and null excluded, B−A, detail-page order, imperial conversion without rounding, and real 308/300 records. router.test.ts tests round-trip, encoding and rejection of incomplete or malformed compare routes. Weak points: the compareProfiles test only checks that a !== b, that the path starts with 'M' and null for an empty record, not a common scale or aligned head faces; the shot test only asserts zero differences and an Array result. No component test for accessible names or the select, but the repository has no component-test setup, so lib-level tests follow its convention.
evidence.s3_fixes: Bug: compareRows now takes the union of both maps (A order, then B-only), with empty cell and empty Difference where one side is missing; tests cover synthetic P1/L6 and the real `delta L` (308 only) and `R3` (300 WM only). Style: CSS changed to `th, td {text-align:right} th:first-child, td:first-child {text-align:left}`, the same rule GroupTable.svelte:231-245 uses, so headers and values of the three numeric columns are right-aligned and Symbol stays left. Related wording updates (lede, noShared in en/de) and the changelog entry were adjusted to the new behavior. No regressions seen. The single commit message names only the bug fix.
evidence.cross_step: Step 2 added a Changelog `Added` entry under [Unreleased]; step 3 corrected that unreleased entry. Per CONTRIBUTING the version is bumped only at release, so no version change is expected and none was made. Commits f50e719, b6dbb00 and 26c4084 use feat/fix Conventional Commits. Code typechecks on reading (imports exist, Route union and metadata Record updated, $props.id supported by svelte 5.57); tests are consistent with the implementation, so CI should pass (not run).

strengths: Compare view meets every step 2 requirement precisely (accessible names, exact headers, FIELD_LABELS symbols, unit-preference handling, shared-viewport overlay) while reusing lib/core, lib/geom, lib/shapes2d and the site's components

Coherent release setup: version in site/package.json, tag workflow that checks the version, the changelog section and that the tag is on main, Keep a Changelog stated, Dependabot with prefixes matching the Conventional Commits convention, and every commit following it
Step 3 bug fixed with targeted tests on the real 308 Win./300 Win. Mag. records, and the alignment now follows the detail page's GroupTable rule exactly
issues: No GitHub Action is pinned to a full commit SHA (actions/checkout@v7, setup-node@v7, upload-pages-artifact@v5, deploy-pages@v5); commit ffea5b9 made this deliberate
pages.yml allows workflow_dispatch, so a manual run can deploy any branch unless the github-pages environment's branch protection blocks it
compareProfiles test does not verify a common scale or aligned head faces, and compare.ts duplicates the group ordering of site/src/lib/fields.ts orderedGroups
review.verdict: The feature and the step 3 fixes are correct, well integrated and follow the release and commit conventions set up in step 1. The main blocker to merging as is: none of the workflow actions is pinned to a commit SHA, and the compare drawing's test is weak.
